title: ALBERT factorized embedding plus domain Mirror views
hypothesis: A single per-domain Givens phase applied inside ALBERT-style low-dimensional token embeddings will generalize to held-out token-domain pairs under cyclic domain shifts, exceed hard shared factorized embeddings by at least 0.05 accuracy, and approach post-embedding rank-4 adapters at lower serialized bytes than independent factorized domain tables.
physical_object: one shared 256x8 token embedding matrix and one shared 8x16 projection
mirror_coordinate: one per-domain Givens angle rotating the 8D token representation before projection
logical_multiplicity: eight domain-specific embedding functions from one physical factorized table

model.held_out_split: seeded 25% token-domain pairs; every token and domain occurs in train
model.domain_identity: observed input shared by every method

controls: independent per-domain factorized ALBERT embeddings with shared projection
hard shared factorized embedding with no domain conditioning
post-embedding rank-4 domain adapter in model dimension
post-embedding full domain map upper control
Mirror phase applied inside 8D embedding bottleneck before projection
development_gate_before_fresh: For both seeds on held-out pairs: Mirror >=0.05 accuracy above hard-shared factorized baseline; within 0.03 accuracy and 0.10 NLL of the post-embedding rank-4 adapter; actual payload <=0.85x independent per-domain factorized embedding; and no more than 0.02 seen-pair accuracy loss relative to rank-4. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds pass held-out quality/NLL/bytes and exact payload replay; report seen/heldout transfer, serialized bytes, compute and throughput.
failure_gate: Any development gate misses in either seed; fresh remains unopened.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: shared or independent factorized token tables

boundaries: synthetic cyclic domain shift; not natural ALBERT or multilingual evidence
domain identity is an observed input equally available to all methods
factorization and domain role are distinct insertion points
fresh data remain sealed until all development gates pass
